The deliverable keeps the Workbench and Pipeline selection experience coherent for operators moving from the matrix into interactive personas or operative task categories.
The UX should preserve active agent context, make available pipeline choices visible, prevent stale or invalid selections, and keep UI convenience state subordinate to governed project files.
Principle: preserve context at route boundaries so that when the matrix opens WORKBENCH, the selected agent, row, and column remain visible and recoverable from query parameters (FR-009).
Principle: keep operative selection explicit; PIPELINE exposes DECOMP, PREP, TASK, and AUDIT, and TASK separates agent choice from scope choice (FR-011, FR-012).
Principle: prefer disabled visibility over disappearance for unsupported options so operators see roadmap shape without invoking unavailable behavior.
Principle: reset stale selections rather than carrying invalid state across root or scan changes (FR-013, PRD 7.5).
Principle: treat UI local state as non-authoritative convenience state; project truth remains in working-root files and accepted git history (DIRECTIVE 2.1, 2.2, 2.6).
